# The Stem Cell Institute

## MIRACLE Medical Spa
- [MIRACLE Medical Spa](https://www.thestemcellinstitute.com/miracle-medical-spa/): Four BTL technologies, offered at both clinics after a physician evaluation
- [Emsculpt](https://www.thestemcellinstitute.com/miracle-medical-spa/emsculpt/): Electromagnetic muscle toning and strengthening
- [Emsella](https://www.thestemcellinstitute.com/miracle-medical-spa/emsella/): Pelvic floor chair for urinary incontinence
- [Exomind](https://www.thestemcellinstitute.com/miracle-medical-spa/exomind/): Transcranial magnetic stimulation for eligible adults with depression
- [Emvital](https://www.thestemcellinstitute.com/miracle-medical-spa/emvital/): Therapeutic heat for temporary muscle and joint relief
